address: 8 Soi Srinagarindra 56, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok, 10250, Thailand
bio: Open for over nine years, this family-run seafood restaurant has its roots in the Saen Sombun legacy. Fresh catch is cooked to order and sent out swiftly, in generous portions made for sharing. There are three dining areas, indoors and out, making it a good choice in Bang Na for families. Do not miss their signature stir-fry from a 50-year-old secret recipe – less sweet than many Chon Buri styles, it is prized for its aromas and balanced flavours.
